svg.title: Figure 1 · Layouts against the review flags
svg.desc: Every concept layout and posture with its placeholder metrics
svg.text: Figure 1 · Layouts against the review flags
The 5 concept layouts and the CL-05 postures, from metrics.json. Red marks a value under a provisional review flag (static margin 0.30 m, rotor clearance 1.0 m); 4 of 8 rows
have one. Flags are not requirements.
Under a provisional review flag (tick = flag)

Generated by tools/figures/cad_readme.py from cad/metrics.json, the layout parameters, the CL-05 findings and the records. Placeholder concept geometry: values are not design data, and flags are not requirements. Static
margin is a standstill measure only; walking needs a dynamic analysis.

g.text: Terms: CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference layout) · DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml)
